How to apply as an international student International students Are you an international student thinking about studying at a UK university? See our information about how to apply, including entry requirements, the visa process, and bursaries and scholarships. Expert advice for international students If you’re an international student looking to study in the UK, contact the representative in your country for advice. They will be available to offer expert advice, guidance and support to help you with your application. Find your country representative How to apply for an undergraduate course in the UK If you’re from outside the UK and want to study with us, you can make your application one of two ways – either via the Universities and Colleges Admissions Service (UCAS) or via our online applications portal . Before submitting your application, you should first check the specific entry requirements for the course in relation to your home country or place of study, as well as the English language requirements, to ensure you are eligible. For those within the EU, you should apply via UCAS rather than directly. UCAS online application UCLan online application system If you are experiencing any issues with completing the online application form, or if you have any questions in relation to your application, please email the International Team inbox . Thinking of applying for medicine? We have put together some guidance to help you with your application. If you do not meet the entry requirements for a course, you could complete a foundation programme with OnCampus or another of our recognised international foundation providers . This will allow you to progress onto a degree at the university. Read more about How to apply for an undergraduate course in the UK How to apply for a postgraduate course in the UK If you're looking to start your postgraduate application and you're from outside the UK, you can apply for our postgraduate courses via our online application portal . You’ll simply need to create an account and work through the application steps as indicated. In general, our postgraduate programmes require a minimum of a lower second class degree from a recognised university, or a professional qualification deemed to be equivalent. In some cases you will need to submit a proposal as part of your degree. Before starting your online application, you should first check the entry requirements and English language requirements in relation to your home country or place of study to ensure you are eligible. Online application If you are experiencing any issues with completing the online application form, or have any questions about the application process, please contact international@uclan.ac.uk Read more about How to apply for a postgraduate course in the UK How to apply for postgraduate research in the UK We have an established research reputation in a wide range of academic disciplines and on completion of your research degree, you should be in a very strong position for pursuing your chosen career. Find out more about how to apply for postgraduate research in the UK . English language entry requirements We accept a range of English language qualifications including IELTS, TOEFL and Pearson Test of English. We can also accept some country specific qualifications. What we can accept as proof of English language level can vary depending on level of study and sometimes the course. For the general English language requirements we accept, please take a look at our English entry requirements webpage . If you would like to check whether we can accept local qualifications, please check your country or region’s entry requirements page . Read more about English language entry requirements Important dates for international applicants Please view our admission deadlines for international applicants below September 2026 dates September 2026 dates Application deadline : 19 July 2026 Deposit deadline : 16 August 2026 Take a virtual tour Can't make it onto campus but want to explore the university? Discover our course facilities, social spaces, accommodation and city hot spots on our virtual tour. Explore our campuses Further information The University of Central Lancashire is a diverse environment, which brings people into contact with each other in a wide variety of ways. The University community includes students who are children (those under the age of 18) and vulnerable adults. We have a duty to safeguard these groups of individuals, as well as a duty to provide a safe environment in which our staff can work and all of our students can study and where relevant, live. We therefore ask all applicants who have accepted a place with us if they have relevant unspent criminal convictions obtained in the UK or other jurisdiction. This is so that we can consider the implications of any convictions, assess any risks to you or others within the University environment and determine whether we can reasonably manage any risks to enable you to take up your place here. Having a relevant unspent conviction therefore is not an automatic barrier to taking up your place on your chosen programme. Therefore, if you accept an offer the University will ask you to disclose details about relevant unspent convictions and supporting information. Useful links Visa advice Find out whether you need a visa, how to apply, and what documents you may need. Read more about Visa advice English language entry requirements Looking for the English language requirements for international students? Take a look at the English qualification requirements you would need to study at the University of Central Lancashire. Read more about English language entry requirements Scholarships and bursaries We believe that opportunity creates success, and that’s why we offer a range of attractive bursaries, scholarships, funds and discounts to our prospective students to give them a helping hand along the way. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). We’re proud to be an international university, with a thriving staff and student community of over 38,000 people from over 100 countries. We offer a welcoming place for all our international students, encouraging you to become a global citizen. We support your success in study, with courses that lead to global career opportunities. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more. Visit 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement International partner enquiries If you have a general enquiry, let us know and we'll pass it to the relevant team. Submit your enquiry Our international partners Open all accordion items Bangladesh Universal College Bangladesh (UCB) Universal College Bangladesh (UCB) is a pioneer in delivering international higher education programmes in Bangladesh. UCB is where excellence meets accessibility, and where every Bangladeshi student can have a world class educational experience leading to globally recognised qualifications. UCB’s aim is to give every student in Bangladesh the opportunity to get international qualifications from some of the world’s leading higher education institutions. UCB are the first transnational education (TNE) provider to be given all the relevant permissions by the Ministry of Education to offer international degree courses and pathway programmes, in the Country. UCB were recently approved by the Ministry of Education to deliver 3-year programmes in-country and will be delivering the following franchised programme for delivery from November 2024 at the UCB Dhaka city centre campus: BSc (Hons) Business and Marketing January 2025 and subject to validation* : BSc (Hons) Cyber Security* BSc (Hons) Software Engineering* UCB’s vision is as a world class education institution providing students the skills required to become work-ready professionals who can contribute to the social and economic development globally. Visit the UCB website Contact Phone: +880 1886-412222 / +880 1896-013882 / +880 1844-277342 / +880 1844-277343 Email: admission@ucbbd.org Address Universal College Bangladesh SA Tower, 1 Gulshan Avenue, Dhaka – 1212 Office Hours: 8:00 AM to 6pm BST (Saturday to Thursday) Egypt Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) – El Alamein Campus The Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) is located in El Alamein, Egypt and was established in 1972. For over 49 years, AASTMT has managed to keep up with the fast pace of development in the fields of education, training, consultation and scientific research. With its strong belief in the importance of Arab integration through enhancing joint Arab cooperation with the ultimate aim of attaining integrated Arab collaboration in all scientific fields, AASTMT has managed to accomplish further achievements in the fields of education, training and research. It has served the Arab community by providing education for both undergraduate and graduate students in over 35 specialisations. These include maritime transport, engineering, computers and information technology, international transport and logistics, management, language, media, law, pharmacy, fisheries and aquaculture technology, archaeology and finally dentistry and artificial intelligence. The institutional partnership with AASTMT enables students to access a wide range of our Engineering programmes through a dual degree partnership. Visit the AASTMT website . Contact Address: Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime Transport El Alamein. Alamein Branch - El Alameen City El Alamein Matrouh Governorate European Universities in Egypt (EUE) The European Universities in Egypt (EUE) is established according to the presidential decree no.86 of the year 2021 and is based in the New Administrative Capital of Egypt. EUE is a higher education institution offering transnational education by bringing together reputable international universities to create a unique hub in the MENA region. Through partnerships with international universities, the EUE offers degree programmes in a diverse range of disciplines while granting its students the degree of the respective university. EUE will provide its students with state-of-the-art learning and research experiences to meet the needs of the emerging Egyptian economy and the international market. It aims to be a novel research hub that nurtures transnational education in the MENA region and makes a socio-economic impact across all collaborating markets. EUE aspires to be a distinguished and pioneering institution in higher education and scientific research. By hosting distinguished branches from world-ranked universities, EUE aims to graduate world-class students who will contribute to shape the future of their country and humanity. EUE campus aims to: Offer a safe and comfortable environment that assists students to excel and create; Endorse student learning through excellence in teaching support services and instructional delivery using both e-learning and traditional settings in response to current industry demands; and Foster an institutional culture that values diversity and cross-cultural competencies and skills identified by global industry experts. Greece College for Humanistic Sciences (ICPS), Greece The College for Humanistic Sciences (ICPS) is a longstanding partner of the University, responsible for delivering various franchise programmes. They are the only college in Greece to have been specialising in the science of human behaviour since 1989. Since the College was re-authorised by the Ministry of Education in 2013, it has made huge leaps in becoming a specialist institution in the field of human behaviour. The College is certified by the Pearson-Edexcel Training Center, the world’s largest professional certification body, and offers lifelong and distance programmes in Counselling, Learning Difficulties, and Counselling for Couples. Working alongside the Greek EFT Network, ICPS offer an array of approved programmes that meet the EFT Therapist criteria. This gives students the unique advantage of gaining double certification within the subject field, giving them a distinct advantage in their careers. Furthermore, ICPS trainers travel globally to do speeches and workshops. This includes speaking at the World Conference on Personal Counselling and Psychotherapy in New York. In July 2017, ICPS became a founding member of the Pan-Hellenic Association of Recognised Colleges. This means that the College plays a key role in the field of education in Greece and aspires to work with universities abroad. This initiative led to our current collaboration – we now offer MSc Applied Clinical Psychology and MSc Psychology (Conversion) courses which are based in Greece. Find out more about the College for Humanistic Sciences on their website . Contact Phone: +30.210.64.56.565 Email: reception@icps.edu.gr Address : 56a Filikon str. & Kanari 121 31 Agios Antonios, Peristeri Athens, Greece. Hong Kong (SAR) City University of Hong Kong, School of Continuing & Professional Education (SCOPE) Our partners at the School of Continuing and Professional Education (SCOPE) at City University in Hong Kong offer courses related to Fire Engineering, Fire Safety Engineering, English for International Corporate Communication and International Business Communication. Their fire safety programmes have been developed to serve the needs of the Hong Kong Fire Services Authority. Since its development in 1991, SCOPE has been a pioneer and major provider of quality professional education and training in Hong Kong. The School offers a range of programmes at different levels. Their bachelor’s degree programmes focus on professional education in a variety of disciplines. Their postgraduate programmes are specialist, delivering academically sound and career-relevant content which meets the needs of surrounding communities and reflects ongoing social and technological changes. Over the past two decades, the School has worked alongside us to provide bachelor’s degrees to a high standard, ensuring that we are developing knowledgeable and highly employable graduates within key sectors. Franchised courses: BA (Hons) English for International Corporate Communication BA (Hons) International Business Communication (with Japanese/Chinese) Foundation Fire Safety Engineering BEng (Hons) Fire Engineering MSc Fire Safety Engineering MSc Fire Scene Investigation Find out more about SCOPE on their website . Contact Phone: 00 852 3442 7423 Email: scope@cityu.edu.hk Address: 2410, 2/F, Li Dak Sum Yip Yio Chin Academic Building (LI) City University of Hong Kong Tat Chee Avenue, Kowloon Hong Kong Hong Kong College of Technology, (Hong Kong Institute of Higher Education) We have enjoyed a very successful relationship with the Centre of International Education at Hong Kong College of Technology (HKCT) since 2005. The initial collaboration was in the areas of construction project management, facilities management and marketing. Our courses have greatly benefited industries throughout Hong Kong. HKCT and its predecessor, Mong Kok Workers’ Night School, was formed with the aim of addressing large-scale redundancies and educational problems in post-war Hong Kong. For more than 70 years, its mission and ethos have evolved continuously to adapt to the changing demands of society (from literacy education at Mong Kok Workers’ Night School in the 1940s and 1950s and school skill labour training in the 1960s, to professional education in the 1970s and 1980s, and retraining in the 1990s). Their programmes now extend to post-secondary education, including the delivery of outstanding academic degrees. In 2014, HKCT Institute of Higher Education was approved by the Chief Executive in-Council as it became the nineteenth degree-awarding higher education institution in Hong Kong. HKCT is committed to professional career education and delivers a variety of programmes, including full-time and part-time degrees and diplomas, with an emphasis on applied skills and meeting the labour demands of Hong Kong’s industries – to date they have provided over 600,000 qualified students. Franchised programmes: BSc (Hons) Construction Project Management BSc (Hons) Facilities Management MSc Construction Project Management Find out more about Hong Kong College of Technology on their website . We have been working with the VTC for many years and now offer a wide range of courses in Engineering related subjects. The School for Higher and Professional Education (SHAPE) is a member institution of the VTC. Since its establishment in 2003, SHAPE has been providing quality top-up degree programmes in a wide range of professions by working closely with partner institutions. Through collaborating with us and many other universities across the world, graduates will earn a reputable and recognised top-up degree in Hong Kong. Both full-time and part-time study options are available to suit the needs of every student. In the academic year 2020-21, some 44 accredited programmes are pitched at Level 5 under the Hong Kong Qualifications Framework. SHAPE offers programmes in Engineering and other areas, including Applied Science; Business; Childcare; Elderly and Community Services; Design; Hospitality, Tourism and Leisure; and Information Technology. Franchised programmes: BSc (Hons) Building Surveying BSc (Hons) Quantity Surveying BEng (Hons) Building Services and Sustainable Engineering BSc (Hons) Architectural Studies Contact Phone: 00 852 25952771 Email: shape@vtc.edu.hk Address: SHAPE Central Office Room 008, Academic Block 30 Shing Tai Road, Chai Wan, Hong Kong Malaysia IMU University The International Medical University (IMU) is Malaysia’s first and most established private medical and healthcare university, with more than 25 years of dedicated experience in healthcare education. IMU is also the first university in Malaysia to offer both conventional and complementary medicine under one institution. Established in 1992, IMU was the first private higher education institution in Malaysia authorised to confer academic degrees, and it was granted full university status by the Malaysian government in 1999. IMU offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, health sciences, and complementary medicine, delivered through modern teaching facilities, laboratories, clinical training centres, and strong partnerships with healthcare providers. Students who meet the published entry criteria for the articulation arrangement may be eligible to progress to the MBBS (Hons) (Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery) Year 3 Entry. Programme availability, entry requirements, and progression routes are kept under review and may change. The partnership looks forward to sharing any future developments and additional programme options as they are confirmed. Visit International Medical University Website SEGi University, Malaysia SEGi University and Colleges first opened its doors as Systematic College in 1977 in the heart of Kuala Lumpur’s commercial district, offering globally recognised professional qualifications. Since then, SEGi has experienced significant growth by adapting and catering to an increasing demand for tertiary education and professional qualifications in Malaysia. We are proud to have SEGi University as our partners in Malaysia. A leading private higher education institution, they deliver innovative programmes to cater to the needs of industry and the wider community, nationally and internationally. We have collaborated on a suite of courses designed to equip students with highly employable skills and knowledge. When students graduate they receive a double degree qualification – which means they receive certification from both ourselves and SEGi to demonstrate their expertise and enhance their employment prospects. The courses we deliver collaboratively with SEGi include: BA (Hons) Education BEng (Hons) Engineering BA (Hons) Hospitality Management BSc (Hons) Information Technology BA (Hons) International Business Administration BA (Hons) International Accounting BA (Hons) International Accounting and Finance BA (Hons) Mass Communications BA (Hons) Public Relations with English Find out more about SEGi University on their website . Contact Phone: 00 603 6145 1777 Email: infokd@segi.edu.my Address: SEGi University Jalan Teknologi Kota Damansara 47810 Petaling Jaya Selangor, Malaysia Mauritius UOM Enterprise Ltd UOM Enterprise Ltd was created in 2010 by the University of Mauritius Trust and is registered as a post-secondary educational institution. We entered a partnership with UOME in 2011 to deliver numerous courses in Mauritius. UOME was established by the UOM Trust (a charitable trust set up by the University of Mauritius) to respond to the training needs of the African continent. They boast brand new teaching facilities, providing top-class programmes for ambitious students. Our LLM in International Business Law has been operating within Mauritius since 2011 and the curriculum has been highly praised by the professional law community as an outstanding source of skills and knowledge for students. In order to diversify the programme on offer in Mauritius, and after three years of delivering an LLM in International Business Law, we worked alongside UOME to launch various undergraduate and postgraduate courses within the fields of Law and Construction in 2014. All of them have gone through the rigorous process of accreditation by the TEC and the Quality Assurance Agency for Higher Education to provide students with fully recognised qualifications. In 2019, we celebrated a record number of students graduating from UOME across a range of courses. There were more students than ever graduating from our LLB and LLM programmes and, for the first time, there were students graduating from our Graduate Diploma in Law (GDL). Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). We’re proud to be an international university, with a thriving staff and student community of over 38,000 people from over 100 countries. We offer a welcoming place for all our international students, encouraging you to become a global citizen. We support your success in study, with courses that lead to global career opportunities. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). We’re proud to be an international university, with a thriving staff and student community of over 38,000 people from over 100 countries. We offer a welcoming place for all our international students, encouraging you to become a global citizen. We support your success in study, with courses that lead to global career opportunities. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more. Visit 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement International partner enquiries If you have a general enquiry, let us know and we'll pass it to the relevant team. Working alongside the Greek EFT Network, ICPS offer an array of approved programmes that meet the EFT Therapist criteria. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). We’re proud to be an international university, with a thriving staff and student community of over 38,000 people from over 100 countries. We offer a welcoming place for all our international students, encouraging you to become a global citizen. We support your success in study, with courses that lead to global career opportunities. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more. Visit 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement International partner enquiries If you have a general enquiry, let us know and we'll pass it to the relevant team. Through partnerships with international universities, the EUE offers degree programmes in a diverse range of disciplines while granting its students the degree of the respective university. Greece College for Humanistic Sciences (ICPS), Greece The College for Humanistic Sciences (ICPS) is a longstanding partner of the University, responsible for delivering various franchise programmes. They are the only college in Greece to have been specialising in the science of human behaviour since 1989. Since the College was re-authorised by the Ministry of Education in 2013, it has made huge leaps in becoming a specialist institution in the field of human behaviour. The College is certified by the Pearson-Edexcel Training Center, the world’s largest professional certification body, and offers lifelong and distance programmes in Counselling, Learning Difficulties, and Counselling for Couples. Working alongside the Greek EFT Network, ICPS offer an array of approved programmes that meet the EFT Therapist criteria. This gives students the unique advantage of gaining double certification within the subject field, giving them a distinct advantage in their careers. Furthermore, ICPS trainers travel globally to do speeches and workshops. This includes speaking at the World Conference on Personal Counselling and Psychotherapy in New York. In July 2017, ICPS became a founding member of the Pan-Hellenic Association of Recognised Colleges. This means that the College plays a key role in the field of education in Greece and aspires to work with universities abroad. This initiative led to our current collaboration – we now offer MSc Applied Clinical Psychology and MSc Psychology (Conversion) courses which are based in Greece. Find out more about the College for Humanistic Sciences on their website . Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). We’re proud to be an international university, with a thriving staff and student community of over 38,000 people from over 100 countries. We offer a welcoming place for all our international students, encouraging you to become a global citizen. We support your success in study, with courses that lead to global career opportunities. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. Study at a partner International partners International partners Study at a partner Internationalisation and partnership are at the heart of our corporate strategy. We have nurtured a diverse network of international partners overseas and value our reputation as a successful partnership institution. A diverse network of partners all over the globe We forged our first overseas transnational education collaboration in 1986. Thanks to this we are now engaged globally on programmes ranging over a variety of aspects. This range from staff and student exchanges, progression partners (articulations) to validated programmes. We also work in collaborative research, knowledge transfer and joint project ventures. We are proud to be at the forefront of higher education globalisation. We work in collaboration with governing bodies, ministries of education and international organisations. We provide staff and students with real-world international opportunities both at home and across the world. Awards 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement We’ve been awarded the maximum 5 QS Stars (Excellent) for global engagement and internationalisation (2025). We’re proud to be an international university, with a thriving staff and student community of over 38,000 people from over 100 countries. We offer a welcoming place for all our international students, encouraging you to become a global citizen. We support your success in study, with courses that lead to global career opportunities. Our 5 QS Stars also reflects the opportunities we give for you to experience other cultures. We're proudly connected with our overseas campus in Cyprus. We also have over 120 international partnerships with universities in China, Malaysia, the Far East, and more.
